summary.text: Qing Clan Inheritance is the sealed legacy Qing clan's first supreme elder buried in green ghost desert. Inheritance requires revenge against Spectral Soul or his kin.

claims.text: Although Spectral Soul slaughtered Qing clan before becoming a venerable, rumor holds that Qing clan’s first supreme elder sealed all clan resources and buried them in green ghost desert, leaving behind an inheritance. The sole stated condition is that the inheritor take revenge for Qing clan by killing Spectral Soul; if Spectral Soul is already dead, revenge targets his family, friends, and disciples. After Spectral Soul became a Demon Venerable the inheritance became a joke in that era, yet Fang clan, nearest to green ghost desert, searched for clues across generations until the clues were complete and a responsive method let them begin searching the desert. Clues mention Immortal Gu House Divine Bean Palace, created by Genesis Lotus Immortal Venerable and left in Western Desert, which drives Fang clan’s multi-generation resolve.
The Qing clan inheritance that Fang clan had coveted for generations appears before Fang clan immortals when Divine Bean Palace assaults Fang Yuan in green ghost desert.
